title: SimpleVoiceDistance
description: Bridge for Simple Voice Distance on Paper/Spigot with Fabric and Forge support.
body:
# 🎤 SimpleVoiceDistance Bridge (PaperSpigot)

SimpleVoiceDistance Bridge detects players using the [SimpleVoiceDistance](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/simplevoicedistance) mod and enables support for it on the server side.

***

## ✨ Features

*   🔍 Detects players using the **SimpleVoiceDistance** mod
*   🎚️ Configurable voice ranges:
    *   Whisper
    *   Normal
    *   Call
    *   Shout

***

## 💬 Commands

*   `/svd list` — Lists detected mod users

***
## ⚙️ Setup

1. 📁 Place the plugin `.jar`, **Simple Voice Chat** and **SimpleVoiceDistance** into your `plugins` folder
2. ▶️ Start the server once
3. 🛠️ Adjust the config if needed
4. 🔄 Restart the server
